hallucinations.claim: Used CSS custom property `--media-control-bar-background` to set the control-bar background via inline style on `<MuxPlayer>`
hallucinations.reality: This CSS variable is not part of Mux Player's or media-chrome's published styling API. media-chrome exposes `--media-control-background`, `--media-control-hover-background`, and `--media-background-color`, but no `--media-control-bar-background`. (Verified against https://www.media-chrome.org/docs/en/reference/styling)
hallucinations.evidence: Edit in rung-3 line 3: `style={{ "--media-control-bar-background": "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)" } as React.CSSProperties}`

hallucinations.reality: `control-bar` is not a part name exposed by Mux Player. Mux Player's published part list contains `top`, `center`, `bottom`, `layer`, `media-layer`, `poster-layer`, `vertical-layer`, `centered-layer`, `gesture-layer`, `poster`, `live`, `play`, `button`, `seek-backward`, `seek-forward`, `mute`, `captions`, `airplay`, `pip`, `fullscreen`, `cast`, `playback-rate`, `volume`, `range`, `time`, `display`, `video` — control bars are addressed via the positional `top`/`bottom` parts. (https://github.com/muxinc/elements/blob/main/packages/mux-player/REFERENCE.md)
`control-bar` is not an exposed part name. The bottom control bar is selectable via `::part(bottom)` alone; adding `control-bar` makes the multi-token selector match nothing.
hallucinations.evidence: src/index.css final: `mux-player::part(control-bar bottom) { background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.85)); padding: 0 4px 4px; }`

hallucinations.reality: Same as above — `control-bar` is not a Mux Player part name; the correct selector is `::part(top)`.
hallucinations.evidence: src/index.css final: `mux-player::part(control-bar top) { background: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.6), transparent); }`

hallucinations.reality: Mux Player exposes accent color via the `accent-color` HTML attribute / `accentColor` React prop, not a `--media-accent-color` CSS variable. It is not listed in the media-chrome styling reference and is not documented as a Mux Player styling hook.
hallucinations.evidence: src/index.css final: `mux-player { ... --media-accent-color: #ff0000; ... }` while the same component already sets `accentColor="#ff0000"` as a prop.

notes: Five public-API hallucinations were introduced and partially carried into the final code. The recurring mistake is treating `control-bar` as a Mux Player ::part() name in both rung 3 (`::part(control-bar)`) and rung 5 (`::part(control-bar top)`, `::part(control-bar bottom)`); Mux Player exposes the positional control bars only via `top`/`bottom` parts. Claude also invented two CSS custom properties: `--media-control-bar-background` (rung 3, later dropped) and `--media-accent-color` (rung 5, in final index.css). Other props (`playbackId`, `autoPlay`, `loop`, `muted`, `poster`, `accentColor`), the default-export type import from `@mux/mux-player`, and the remaining `--media-*` variables and part names used (`play button`, `mute button`, `volume range`, `time display`, `seek-backward`, `seek-forward`) match the documented surface.
